name: 29826-mintokens-8b-1gpu
model: NousResearch/Meta-Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct -- the ungated mirror of meta-llama/Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct, same weights, not a substitution.
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3 (one GPU of an a3 node, --gres=gpu:1).
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=1, warmup 15%, bounded at 256 requests.
workload: synthetic_text, single turn, exactly 300 prompt tokens and exactly 300 output tokens, greedy decoding (temperature 0), min_tokens 300 and ignore_eos so every response is exactly 300 tokens.
purpose: A single-user drafting assistant on one H100, streaming 300-token replies from 300-token prompts with an 8B model.
launch:
# The engine's command line. The interpreter and the hardware seal are in configs/env.yaml.
model: NousResearch/Meta-Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct
async-scheduling: true
enable-prefix-caching: false
tensor-parallel-size: 1
pipeline-parallel-size: 1
dtype: bfloat16
max-model-len: 2048
# Equal to max-model-len, so a 300-token prompt prefills in a single step. Pinned because the
# engine's default for this key depends on the device and on how the engine was entered, and is
# otherwise not reproducible.
max-num-batched-tokens: 2048
max-num-seqs: 256
gpu-memory-utilization: 0.90
